baseline.note: The archive holds the DELTA against this commit plus all evidence from this line of work. Files that this line never touched are NOT in the archive; they come from `git checkout <commit> -- .` on a clean clone.

selfContainedWhy: Only modified/new source files are archived, not the whole tree. A full rebuild needs the repository at the baseline commit. Nothing else is required: no network, no generated artefact, no patch application.
restoreRecipe: 2) extract this archive to any directory OUTSIDE the clone
3) copy <extract>/source/src/... over the clone (overwrite, byte for byte)
4) verify: every file in CHECKPOINT_MANIFEST.json must hash to the recorded sha256
5) evidence/ is documentation only — nothing in it is required to build
WARNING: do NOT use `git apply` for this repository; it silently reports "Skipped patch" with exit 0 (see PPC-P1-CLOSURE-FIX-01 report, pitfall 2). Copy bytes instead.
eolContract: Every member is stored with its exact on-disk bytes. src/game/engine.ts is CRLF; every other source file is LF. A restore that normalises line endings changes sha256 and must be treated as failed.
